message: Clancy, I kinda snickered too when I saw the picture -- I mean, Laura Dern and Treat Williams just aren't the two faces I imagine when I read the story. But yeah, I love the site; great to have an actual permission-granted copy of the story online. I haven't read Beasts, but I've enjoyed so much other stuff by her -- Bellefleur and Wonderland are two of my favorite novels; Because It Is Bitter. . ., them, Childwold are great as well, and so many good short stories, especially "How I Contemplated My Life. . ." for its form -- works great as a prompt for fiction writing workshops.
